name: TrueFocus-TS-TW
title: TrueFocus
blurb: Words blur and sharpen in sequence with a glowing corner-bracket highlight…
description: Splits text into words and cycles focus: the focused word is sharp, others blur. A glowing corner-bracket element animates to each focused word. Can cycle automatically or respond to hover in manual mode.
use_when: A headline wants to emphasize words one at a time with visual hierarchy and a sci-fi aesthetic.
avoid_when: When all words need to be readable simultaneously or when constant motion might distract.
a11y: All words remain in the DOM; blur is visual only. Readable in any order.
